sql:
WITH MostCommonCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
)
SELECT 
    molecule_id, element1, element2
FROM 
    MostCommonCombinations
WHERE 
    rn = 1;

WITH ElementCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2,
        COUNT(*) AS combination_count
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
),
MaxCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        molecule_id,
        MAX(combination_count) AS max_combination_count
    FROM 
        ElementCombinations
    GROUP BY 
        molecule_id
)
SELECT 
    ec.molecule_id,
    ec.element1,
    ec.element2,
    ec.combination_count
FROM 
    ElementCombinations ec
JOIN 
    MaxCombinations mc ON ec.molecule_id = mc.molecule_id AND ec.combination_count = mc.max_combination_count;

sql:
WITH ElementCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2,
        COUNT(*) AS combination_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
)
SELECT 
    molecule_id,
    element1,
    element2,
    combination_count
FROM 
    ElementCombinations
WHERE 
    rn = 1;

WITH ElementCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2,
        COUNT(*) AS combination_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
)
SELECT 
    molecule_id,
    element1,
    element2,
    combination_count
FROM 
    ElementCombinations
WHERE 
    rn = 1;

        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2,

    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element

    molecule_id,
    element1,
    element2,
    combination_count
FROM 
    ElementCombinations
WHERE

sql:
WITH ElementCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2,
        COUNT(*) AS combination_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
)
SELECT 
    molecule_id,
    element1,
    element2,
    combination_count
FROM 
    ElementCombinations
WHERE 
    rn = 1;

WITH ElementCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2,
        COUNT(*) AS combination_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn

        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
)
SELECT 
    molecule_id,
    element1,
    element2,
    combination_count
FROM 
    ElementCombinations
WHERE 
    rn = 1;

WITH ElementCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2,
        COUNT(*) AS combination_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
),
MostCommonCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        molecule_id,
        element1,
        element2
    FROM 
        ElementCombinations
    WHERE

)

    atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN 
    atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
JOIN 
    MostCommonCombinations mcc ON a1.element = mcc.element1 AND a2.element = mcc.element2

WITH ElementCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2,
        COUNT(*) AS combination_count
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
),
MaxCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        molecule_id,
        MAX(combination_count) AS max_combination_count
    FROM 
        ElementCombinations
    GROUP BY 
        molecule_id
),

    SELECT 
        ec.molecule_id,
        ec.element1,
        ec.element2
    FROM

    JOIN 
        MaxCombinations mc ON ec.molecule_id = mc.molecule_id AND ec.combination_count = mc.max_combination_count
)

WITH MostCommonCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
    QUALIFY 
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) = 1
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(b.bond_id) AS common_combination_bond_count
FROM 
    bond b
JOIN 
    connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN 
    atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN 
    atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
JOIN 
    MostCommonCombinations mcc ON a1.molecule_id = mcc.molecule_id 
        AND a1.element = mcc.element1 
        AND a2.element = mcc.element2;

sql:
WITH MostCommonCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2,
        COUNT(*) AS combination_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
),
TopCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        molecule_id,
        element1,
        element2
    FROM 
        MostCommonCombinations
    WHERE 
        rn = 1
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS bonds_with_top_combination
FROM 
    connected c
JOIN 
    bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN 
    atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN 
    atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
JOIN 
    TopCombinations tc ON a1.element = tc.element1 AND a2.element = tc.element2
WHERE 
    a1.molecule_id = tc.molecule_id AND a2.molecule_id = tc.molecule_id;

    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN

sql:
WITH MostCommonCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
    QUALIFY 
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) = 1
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(b.bond_id) AS common_combination_bond_count
FROM 
    bond b
JOIN 
    connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN 
    atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN 
    atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
JOIN 
    MostCommonCombinations mcc ON a1.molecule_id = mcc.molecule_id 
        AND a1.element = mcc.element1 
        AND a2.element = mcc.element2;

sql:
WITH MostCommonCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2,
        COUNT(*) AS combination_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
),
TopCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        molecule_id,
        element1,
        element2
    FROM 
        MostCommonCombinations
    WHERE 
        rn = 1
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS bonds_with_top_combination
FROM 
    connected c
JOIN 
    bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN 
    atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN 
    atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
JOIN 
    TopCombinations tc ON a1.element = tc.element1 AND a2.element = tc.element2

WITH MostCommonCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
    QUALIFY 
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) = 1
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(b.bond_id) AS common_combination_bond_count
FROM 
    bond b
JOIN 
    connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN 
    atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN 
    atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
JOIN 
    MostCommonCombinations mcc ON a1.molecule_id = mcc.molecule_id 
        AND a1.element = mcc.element1 
        AND a2.element = mcc.element2;

sql:
WITH loan_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        dist.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            ELSE 'Medium'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        l.status,
        COUNT(*) AS loan_count
    FROM 
        loan l
    JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN 
        district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
    WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        dist.A2, loan_size_category, l.status
),
status_c_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        loan_count AS c_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    WHERE 
        status = 'C'
),
total_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        SUM(loan_count) AS total_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    GROUP BY 
        region, loan_size_category
)
SELECT 
    tc.region,
    tc.loan_size_category,
    COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) AS c_count,
    tc.total_count,
    (COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) * 100.0 / tc.total_count) AS percentage_c
FROM 
    total_counts tc
LEFT JOIN 
    status_c_counts sc ON tc.region = sc.region AND tc.loan_size_category = sc.loan_size_category;

SELECT 
    Country,
    COUNT(DISTINCT GasStationID) AS ValueForMoneyGasStationsCount
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        t.GasStationID,
        g.Country
    FROM 
        transactions_1k t
    JOIN 
        gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
    JOIN (
        SELECT 
            g.Country,
            g.Segment,
            t.ProductID,
            AVG(t.Price) AS AvgPrice
        FROM 
            transactions_1k t
        JOIN 
            gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
        GROUP BY 
            g.Country, g.Segment, t.ProductID
    ) ap ON g.Country = ap.Country AND g.Segment = ap.Segment AND t.ProductID = ap.ProductID
    WHERE 
        t.Price < ap.AvgPrice
) AS ValueForMoneyStations
GROUP BY 
    Country;

WITH loan_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        dist.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            ELSE 'Medium'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        l.status,
        COUNT(*) AS loan_count
    FROM 
        loan l
    JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN 
        district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
    WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        dist.A2, loan_size_category, l.status
),
status_c_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        loan_count AS c_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    WHERE 
        status = 'C'
),
total_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        SUM(loan_count) AS total_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    GROUP BY 
        region, loan_size_category
)
SELECT 
    tc.region,
    tc.loan_size_category,
    COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) AS c_count,
    tc.total_count,
    (COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) * 100.0 / tc.total_count) AS percentage_c
FROM 
    total_counts tc
LEFT JOIN 
    status_c_counts sc ON tc.region = sc.region AND tc.loan_size_category = sc.loan_size_category
ORDER BY 
    tc.region, tc.loan_size_category;

WITH ElementCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2,
        COUNT(*) AS combination_count
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
),
MaxCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        molecule_id,
        MAX(combination_count) AS max_combination_count
    FROM 
        ElementCombinations
    GROUP BY 
        molecule_id
),
MostCommonCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        ec.molecule_id,
        ec.element1,
        ec.element2
    FROM 
        ElementCombinations ec
    JOIN 
        MaxCombinations mc ON ec.molecule_id = mc.molecule_id AND ec.combination_count = mc.max_combination_count
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS most_common_combination_bond_count
FROM 
    bond b
JOIN 
    connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN 
    atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN 
    atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
JOIN 
    molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN 
    MostCommonCombinations mcc ON m.molecule_id = mcc.molecule_id AND a1.element = mcc.element1 AND a2.element = mcc.element2;

WITH loan_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        dist.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            ELSE 'Medium'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        l.status,
        COUNT(*) AS loan_count
    FROM 
        loan l
    JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN 
        district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
    WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        dist.A2, loan_size_category, l.status
),
status_c_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        loan_count AS c_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    WHERE 
        status = 'C'
),
total_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        SUM(loan_count) AS total_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    GROUP BY 
        region, loan_size_category
)
SELECT 
    tc.region,
    tc.loan_size_category,
    COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) AS c_count,
    tc.total_count,
    (COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) * 100.0 / tc.total_count) AS c_percentage

    total_counts tc

    status_c_counts sc ON tc.region = sc.region AND tc.loan_size_category = sc.loan_size_category;

        dist.A2 AS region,
        CASE

        region,
        loan_size_category,
        loan_count AS c_count

    WHERE

total_counts AS (

FROM 
    total_counts tc

WITH loan_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        dist.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            ELSE 'Medium'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        l.status,
        COUNT(*) AS loan_count
    FROM 
        loan l
    JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN 
        district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
    WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        dist.A2, loan_size_category, l.status
),
status_c_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        loan_count AS c_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    WHERE 
        status = 'C'
),
total_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        SUM(loan_count) AS total_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    GROUP BY 
        region, loan_size_category
)
SELECT 
    tc.region,
    tc.loan_size_category,
    COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) AS c_count,
    tc.total_count,
    (COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) * 100.0 / tc.total_count) AS percentage_c
FROM 
    total_counts tc
LEFT JOIN 
    status_c_counts sc ON tc.region = sc.region AND tc.loan_size_category = sc.loan_size_category
ORDER BY 
    tc.region, tc.loan_size_category;

sql:
WITH loan_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        dist.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            ELSE 'Medium'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        l.status,
        COUNT(*) AS loan_count
    FROM 
        loan l
    JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN 
        district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
    WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        dist.A2, loan_size_category, l.status
),
status_c_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        loan_count AS c_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    WHERE 
        status = 'C'
),
total_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        SUM(loan_count) AS total_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    GROUP BY 
        region, loan_size_category
)
SELECT 
    tc.region,
    tc.loan_size_category,
    COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) AS c_count,
    tc.total_count,
    (COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) * 100.0 / tc.total_count) AS percentage_c
FROM 
    total_counts tc
LEFT JOIN 
    status_c_counts sc ON tc.region = sc.region AND tc.loan_size_category = sc.loan_size_category
ORDER BY 
    tc.region, tc.loan_size_category;

WITH loan_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        dist.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            ELSE 'Medium'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        l.status,
        COUNT(*) AS loan_count
    FROM 
        loan l

        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN 
        district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
    WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        dist.A2, loan_size_category, l.status
),
status_c_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        loan_count AS status_c_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    WHERE 
        status = 'C'
),
total_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        SUM(loan_count) AS total_loans
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    GROUP BY 
        region, loan_size_category
)
SELECT 
    tc.region,
    tc.loan_size_category,
    (tc.status_c_count * 100.0) / t.total_loans AS percentage_c
FROM

    GROUP BY

WITH loan_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        dist.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            ELSE 'Medium'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        l.status,
        COUNT(*) AS loan_count
    FROM 
        loan l
    JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN 
        district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
    WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        dist.A2, loan_size_category, l.status
),
status_c_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        loan_count AS c_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    WHERE 
        status = 'C'
),
total_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        SUM(loan_count) AS total_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    GROUP BY 
        region, loan_size_category
),
percentage_c AS (
    SELECT 
        tc.region,
        tc.loan_size_category,
        COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) AS c_count,
        tc.total_count,
        (COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) * 100.0 / tc.total_count) AS percentage_c
    FROM 
        total_counts tc
    LEFT JOIN 
        status_c_counts sc ON tc.region = sc.region AND tc.loan_size_category = sc.loan_size_category
)
SELECT 
    AVG(percentage_c) AS overall_average_percentage_c
FROM 
    percentage_c;

sql:
WITH ElementCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2,
        COUNT(*) AS combination_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
),
MostCommonCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        molecule_id,
        element1,
        element2
    FROM 
        ElementCombinations
    WHERE 
        rn = 1
),
MostCommonCombinationBonds AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS most_common_combination_bonds
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        MostCommonCombinations mcc ON a1.element = mcc.element1 AND a2.element = mcc.element2
),
TotalBonds AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(DISTINCT bond_id) AS total_bonds
    FROM 
        bond
)
SELECT 
    (most_common_combination_bonds * 100.0 / total_bonds) AS percentage
FROM 
    MostCommonCombinationBonds, TotalBonds;

sql:
WITH MostCommonCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2,
        COUNT(*) AS combination_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
),
TopCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        molecule_id,
        element1,
        element2
    FROM 
        MostCommonCombinations
    WHERE 
        rn = 1
),
BondsWithTopCombination AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS bonds_with_top_combination
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        TopCombinations tc ON a1.element = tc.element1 AND a2.element = tc.element2
    WHERE 
        a1.molecule_id = tc.molecule_id AND a2.molecule_id = tc.molecule_id
),
TotalBonds AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(DISTINCT bond_id) AS total_bonds
    FROM 
        bond
)
SELECT 
    (bonds_with_top_combination * 100.0 / total_bonds) AS percentage_of_bonds_with_top_combination
FROM 
    BondsWithTopCombination, TotalBonds;

WITH loan_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        dist.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            ELSE 'Medium'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        l.status,
        COUNT(*) AS loan_count
    FROM 
        loan l
    JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN 
        district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
    WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        dist.A2, loan_size_category, l.status
),
status_c_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        loan_count AS c_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    WHERE 
        status = 'C'
),
total_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        SUM(loan_count) AS total_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    GROUP BY 
        region, loan_size_category
),
percentage_c AS (
    SELECT 
        tc.region,
        tc.loan_size_category,
        COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) AS c_count,
        tc.total_count,
        (COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) * 100.0 / tc.total_count) AS percentage_c
    FROM 
        total_counts tc
    LEFT JOIN 
        status_c_counts sc ON tc.region = sc.region AND tc.loan_size_category = sc.loan_size_category
)
SELECT 
    AVG(percentage_c) AS overall_average_percentage_c
FROM 
    percentage_c;

sql:
WITH MostCommonCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2,
        COUNT(*) AS combination_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
),
TopCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        molecule_id,
        element1,
        element2
    FROM 
        MostCommonCombinations
    WHERE 
        rn = 1
),
BondsWithTopCombination AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS bonds_with_top_combination
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        TopCombinations tc ON a1.element = tc.element1 AND a2.element = tc.element2
    WHERE 
        a1.molecule_id = tc.molecule_id AND a2.molecule_id = tc.molecule_id
),
TotalBonds AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(DISTINCT bond_id) AS total_bonds
    FROM 
        bond
)
SELECT 
    (bonds_with_top_combination * 100.0 / total_bonds) AS percentage_of_bonds_with_top_combination
FROM 
    BondsWithTopCombination, TotalBonds;

WITH loan_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        dist.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            ELSE 'Medium'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        l.status,
        COUNT(*) AS loan_count
    FROM 
        loan l
    JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN 
        district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
    WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        dist.A2, loan_size_category, l.status
),
status_c_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        loan_count AS status_c_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    WHERE 
        status = 'C'
),
total_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        SUM(loan_count) AS total_loans
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    GROUP BY 
        region, loan_size_category
),
percentage_c AS (
    SELECT 
        tc.region,
        tc.loan_size_category,
        (tc.status_c_count * 100.0) / t.total_loans AS percentage_c
    FROM 
        status_c_counts tc
    JOIN 
        total_counts t ON tc.region = t.region AND tc.loan_size_category = t.loan_size_category
)
SELECT 
    AVG(percentage_c) AS overall_average_percentage_c
FROM 
    percentage_c;

        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN

WITH loan_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        dist.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            ELSE 'Medium'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        l.status,
        COUNT(*) AS loan_count
    FROM 
        loan l
    JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN 
        district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
    WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        dist.A2, loan_size_category, l.status
),
status_c_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        loan_count AS c_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    WHERE 
        status = 'C'
),
total_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        SUM(loan_count) AS total_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    GROUP BY 
        region, loan_size_category
),
percentage_c AS (
    SELECT 
        tc.region,
        tc.loan_size_category,
        COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) AS c_count,
        tc.total_count,
        (COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) * 100.0 / tc.total_count) AS percentage_c
    FROM 
        total_counts tc
    LEFT JOIN 
        status_c_counts sc ON tc.region = sc.region AND tc.loan_size_category = sc.loan_size_category
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(percentage_c) AS overall_average_percentage_c
    FROM 
        percentage_c
)
SELECT 
    pc.region,
    pc.loan_size_category,
    pc.c_count,
    pc.total_count,
    pc.percentage_c,
    oa.overall_average_percentage_c,
    CASE 
        WHEN pc.percentage_c > oa.overall_average_percentage_c THEN 'Above Average'
        ELSE 'Below Average'
    END AS performance_comparison
FROM 
    percentage_c pc,
    overall_average oa;

WITH ElementCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2,
        COUNT(*) AS combination_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
),
MostCommonCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        molecule_id,
        element1,
        element2
    FROM 
        ElementCombinations
    WHERE 
        rn = 1
),
MostCommonCombinationBonds AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS most_common_combination_bonds
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        MostCommonCombinations mcc ON a1.element = mcc.element1 AND a2.element = mcc.element2
),
TotalBonds AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(DISTINCT bond_id) AS total_bonds
    FROM 
        bond
)
SELECT 
    (most_common_combination_bonds * 100.0 / total_bonds) AS percentage
FROM 
    MostCommonCombinationBonds, TotalBonds;

WITH MostCommonCombinationBonds AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS most_common_combination_bond_count
    FROM 
        bond b
    JOIN 
        connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    JOIN 
        (SELECT 
            ec.molecule_id,
            ec.element1,
            ec.element2
         FROM 
            (SELECT 
                m.molecule_id,
                a1.element AS element1,
                a2.element AS element2,
                COUNT(*) AS combination_count
             FROM 
                connected c
             JOIN 
                atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
             JOIN 
                atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
             JOIN 
                molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
             WHERE 
                a1.element < a2.element
             GROUP BY 
                m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element) ec
         JOIN 
            (SELECT 
                molecule_id,
                MAX(combination_count) AS max_combination_count
             FROM 
                (SELECT 
                    m.molecule_id,
                    a1.element AS element1,
                    a2.element AS element2,
                    COUNT(*) AS combination_count
                 FROM 
                    connected c
                 JOIN 
                    atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
                 JOIN 
                    atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
                 JOIN 
                    molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
                 WHERE 
                    a1.element < a2.element
                 GROUP BY 
                    m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element) ec
             GROUP BY 
                molecule_id) mc ON ec.molecule_id = mc.molecule_id AND ec.combination_count = mc.max_combination_count
    )
),
TotalBonds AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(DISTINCT bond_id) AS total_bond_count
    FROM 
        bond
)
SELECT 
    (most_common_combination_bond_count * 100.0 / total_bond_count) AS percentage
FROM 
    MostCommonCombinationBonds, TotalBonds;

WITH loan_counts AS (

            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            ELSE 'Medium'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        l.status,

total_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        SUM(loan_count) AS total_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    GROUP BY 
        region, loan_size_category
),
percentage_c AS (
    SELECT 
        tc.region,
        tc.loan_size_category,
        COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) AS c_count,
        tc.total_count,
        (COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) * 100.0 / tc.total_count) AS percentage_c
    FROM 
        total_counts tc
    LEFT JOIN 
        status_c_counts sc ON tc.region = sc.region AND tc.loan_size_category = sc.loan_size_category
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(percentage_c) AS overall_average_percentage_c
    FROM 
        percentage_c
)

    pc.region,
    pc.loan_size_category,
    pc.percentage_c,
    oa.overall_average_percentage_c,
    (pc.percentage_c - oa.overall_average_percentage_c) AS difference_from_average
FROM 
    percentage_c pc,

sql:
WITH MostCommonCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2,
        COUNT(*) AS combination_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
),
TopCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        molecule_id,
        element1,
        element2
    FROM 
        MostCommonCombinations
    WHERE 
        rn = 1
),
BondsWithTopCombination AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS bonds_with_top_combination
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        TopCombinations tc ON a1.element = tc.element1 AND a2.element = tc.element2
    WHERE 
        a1.molecule_id = tc.molecule_id AND a2.molecule_id = tc.molecule_id
),
TotalBonds AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(DISTINCT bond_id) AS total_bonds
    FROM 
        bond
)
SELECT 
    (bonds_with_top_combination * 100.0 / total_bonds) AS percentage_of_bonds_with_top_combination
FROM 
    BondsWithTopCombination, TotalBonds;

            ELSE 'Medium'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        l.status,

status_c_counts AS (

    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        SUM(loan_count) AS total_count
    FROM

),
percentage_c AS (
    SELECT 
        tc.region,

        COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) AS c_count,

WITH loan_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        dist.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            ELSE 'Medium'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        l.status,
        COUNT(*) AS loan_count
    FROM 
        loan l
    JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN 
        district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
    WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        dist.A2, loan_size_category, l.status
),
status_c_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        loan_count AS status_c_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    WHERE 
        status = 'C'
),
total_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        SUM(loan_count) AS total_loans
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    GROUP BY 
        region, loan_size_category
),
percentage_c AS (
    SELECT 
        tc.region,
        tc.loan_size_category,
        (tc.status_c_count * 100.0) / t.total_loans AS percentage_c
    FROM 
        status_c_counts tc
    JOIN 
        total_counts t ON tc.region = t.region AND tc.loan_size_category = t.loan_size_category
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(percentage_c) AS overall_average_percentage_c
    FROM 
        percentage_c
)
SELECT 
    p.region,
    p.loan_size_category,
    p.percentage_c,
    p.percentage_c - o.overall_average_percentage_c AS difference_from_average
FROM 
    percentage_c p,
    overall_average o;

WITH MostCommonCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2,
        COUNT(*) AS combination_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
),
TopCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        molecule_id,
        element1,
        element2
    FROM 
        MostCommonCombinations
    WHERE 
        rn = 1
),
BondsWithTopCombination AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS bonds_with_top_combination
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        TopCombinations tc ON a1.element = tc.element1 AND a2.element = tc.element2
    WHERE 
        a1.molecule_id = tc.molecule_id AND a2.molecule_id = tc.molecule_id
),
TotalBonds AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(DISTINCT bond_id) AS total_bonds
    FROM 
        bond
)
SELECT 
    (bonds_with_top_combination * 100.0 / total_bonds) AS percentage_of_bonds_with_top_combination
FROM 
    BondsWithTopCombination, TotalBonds;

sql:
WITH loan_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        dist.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            ELSE 'Medium'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        l.status,
        COUNT(*) AS loan_count
    FROM 
        loan l
    JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN 
        district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
    WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        dist.A2, loan_size_category, l.status
),
status_c_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        loan_count AS c_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    WHERE 
        status = 'C'
),
total_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        SUM(loan_count) AS total_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    GROUP BY 
        region, loan_size_category
),
percentage_c AS (
    SELECT 
        tc.region,
        tc.loan_size_category,
        COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) AS c_count,
        tc.total_count,
        (COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) * 100.0 / tc.total_count) AS percentage_c
    FROM 
        total_counts tc
    LEFT JOIN 
        status_c_counts sc ON tc.region = sc.region AND tc.loan_size_category = sc.loan_size_category
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(percentage_c) AS overall_average_percentage_c
    FROM 
        percentage_c
)
SELECT 
    pc.region,
    pc.loan_size_category,
    pc.percentage_c,
    oa.overall_average_percentage_c,
    (pc.percentage_c - oa.overall_average_percentage_c) AS difference_from_average
FROM 
    percentage_c pc,
    overall_average oa;

WITH loan_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        dist.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            ELSE 'Medium'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        l.status,
        COUNT(*) AS loan_count
    FROM 
        loan l
    JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN 
        district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
    WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        dist.A2, loan_size_category, l.status
),
status_c_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        loan_count AS status_c_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    WHERE 
        status = 'C'
),
total_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        SUM(loan_count) AS total_loans
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    GROUP BY 
        region, loan_size_category
),
percentage_c AS (
    SELECT 
        tc.region,
        tc.loan_size_category,
        (tc.status_c_count * 100.0) / t.total_loans AS percentage_c
    FROM 
        status_c_counts tc
    JOIN 
        total_counts t ON tc.region = t.region AND tc.loan_size_category = t.loan_size_category
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(percentage_c) AS overall_average_percentage_c
    FROM 
        percentage_c
)
SELECT 
    p.region,
    p.loan_size_category,
    p.percentage_c,
    p.percentage_c - o.overall_average_percentage_c AS difference_from_average
FROM 
    percentage_c p,
    overall_average o;

    (COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) - COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id)) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) AS percentage_without_fluorine,
    AVG(atom_count) AS avg_atoms_per_molecule,

    (SELECT AVG(bond_count) FROM (SELECT m.molecule_id, COUNT(b.bond_id) AS bond_count FROM molecule m JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '+' AND m.molecule_id <> 'TR450' GROUP BY m.molecule_id)) AS avg_bonds_without_fluorine,

sql:
WITH carcinogenic_molecules AS (
  SELECT m.molecule_id
  FROM molecule m
  WHERE m.label = '+'
),
fluorine_molecules AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
  FROM molecule m
  JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
  WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND a.element = 'f'
),
atoms_per_molecule AS (
  SELECT m.molecule_id, COUNT(a.atom_id) AS atom_count
  FROM molecule m
  JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
  WHERE m.label = '+'
  GROUP BY m.molecule_id
),
bonds_per_molecule AS (
  SELECT m.molecule_id, COUNT(b.bond_id) AS bond_count
  FROM molecule m
  JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
  WHERE m.label = '+'
  GROUP BY m.molecule_id
),
bond_strength_per_molecule AS (
  SELECT b.molecule_id,
         AVG(CASE b.bond_type
              WHEN '-' THEN 1
              WHEN '=' THEN 2
              WHEN '#' THEN 3
              ELSE 0
            END) AS bond_strength
  FROM molecule m
  JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
  WHERE m.label = '+'
  GROUP BY b.molecule_id
)
SELECT 
  (COUNT(DISTINCT cm.molecule_id) - COUNT(DISTINCT fm.molecule_id)) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT cm.molecule_id) AS percentage_without_fluorine,
  AVG(apm.atom_count) AS avg_atoms_per_molecule,
  AVG(CASE WHEN fm.molecule_id IS NOT NULL THEN bp.with_fluorine ELSE NULL END) AS avg_bonds_with_fluorine,
  AVG(CASE WHEN fm.molecule_id IS NULL THEN bp.without_fluorine ELSE NULL END) AS avg_bonds_without_fluorine,
  AVG(bs.bond_strength) AS avg_bond_strength
FROM carcinogenic_molecules cm
LEFT JOIN fluorine_molecules fm ON cm.molecule_id = fm.molecule_id
JOIN atoms_per_molecule apm ON cm.molecule_id = apm.molecule_id
JOIN (
  SELECT bp.molecule_id,
         CASE WHEN fm.molecule_id IS NOT NULL THEN bp.bond_count ELSE NULL END AS with_fluorine,
         CASE WHEN fm.molecule_id IS NULL THEN bp.bond_count ELSE NULL END AS without_fluorine
  FROM bonds_per_molecule bp
  LEFT JOIN fluorine_molecules fm ON bp.molecule_id = fm.molecule_id
) bp ON cm.molecule_id = bp.molecule_id
JOIN bond_strength_per_molecule bs ON cm.molecule_id = bs.molecule_id;

WITH loan_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        dist.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            ELSE 'Medium'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        l.status,
        COUNT(*) AS loan_count
    FROM 
        loan l
    JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN 
        district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
    WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        dist.A2, loan_size_category, l.status
),
status_c_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        loan_count AS c_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    WHERE 
        status = 'C'
),
total_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        SUM(loan_count) AS total_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    GROUP BY 
        region, loan_size_category
),
percentage_c AS (
    SELECT 
        tc.region,
        tc.loan_size_category,
        COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) AS c_count,
        tc.total_count,
        (COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) * 100.0 / tc.total_count) AS percentage_c
    FROM 
        total_counts tc
    LEFT JOIN 
        status_c_counts sc ON tc.region = sc.region AND tc.loan_size_category = sc.loan_size_category
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(percentage_c) AS overall_average_percentage_c
    FROM 
        percentage_c
)

    pc.loan_size_category,
    pc.percentage_c,
    oa.overall_average_percentage_c,
    (pc.percentage_c - oa.overall_average_percentage_c) AS difference_from_average
FROM

    overall_average oa

    WHERE m.label = '+'

    SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id

    JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
    WHERE m.label = '+'

    SELECT m.molecule_id, COUNT(a.atom_id) AS atom_count
    FROM molecule m
    JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
    WHERE m.label = '+'
    GROUP BY m.molecule_id
),
bond_counts AS (
    SELECT m.molecule_id, COUNT(b.bond_id) AS bond_count
    FROM molecule m
    JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
    WHERE m.label = '+'
    GROUP BY m.molecule_id
),
bond_strengths AS (
    SELECT b.molecule_id,
           CASE b.bond_type
               WHEN '-' THEN 1
               WHEN '=' THEN 2
               WHEN '#' THEN 3

    WHERE m.label = '+'
)

JOIN bond_counts bc ON cm.molecule_id = bc.molecule_id

WITH ElementCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2,
        COUNT(*) AS combination_count
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
),
MaxCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        molecule_id,
        MAX(combination_count) AS max_combination_count
    FROM 
        ElementCombinations
    GROUP BY 
        molecule_id
),
MostCommonCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        ec.molecule_id,
        ec.element1,
        ec.element2
    FROM 
        ElementCombinations ec
    JOIN 
        MaxCombinations mc ON ec.molecule_id = mc.molecule_id AND ec.combination_count = mc.max_combination_count
),
MostCommonCombinationBonds AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS most_common_combination_bond_count
    FROM 
        bond b
    JOIN 
        connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    JOIN 
        MostCommonCombinations mcc ON m.molecule_id = mcc.molecule_id AND a1.element = mcc.element1 AND a2.element = mcc.element2
),
TotalBonds AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(DISTINCT bond_id) AS total_bond_count
    FROM 
        bond
)
SELECT 
    (most_common_combination_bond_count * 100.0 / total_bond_count) AS percentage
FROM 
    MostCommonCombinationBonds, TotalBonds;

SELECT 
    (COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) - COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id)) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) AS percentage_without_fluorine,
    AVG(atom_count) AS avg_atoms_per_molecule,
    (SELECT AVG(bond_count) FROM (SELECT m.molecule_id, COUNT(b.bond_id) AS bond_count FROM molecule m JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '+' AND m.molecule_id = 'TR450' GROUP BY m.molecule_id)) AS avg_bonds_with_fluorine,
    (SELECT AVG(bond_count) FROM (SELECT m.molecule_id, COUNT(b.bond_id) AS bond_count FROM molecule m JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '+' AND m.molecule_id <> 'TR450' GROUP BY m.molecule_id)) AS avg_bonds_without_fluorine,
    AVG(bond_strength) AS avg_bond_strength
FROM 
    molecule m
LEFT JOIN 
    atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id AND a.element = 'f'
LEFT JOIN 
    (SELECT m.molecule_id, COUNT(a.atom_id) AS atom_count FROM molecule m JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '+' GROUP BY m.molecule_id) atom_counts ON m.molecule_id = atom_counts.molecule_id

    (SELECT b.bond_id, CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 WHEN b.bond_type = '=' THEN 2 WHEN b.bond_type = '#' THEN 3 END AS bond_strength FROM bond b) bond_strengths ON m.molecule_id = bond_strengths.bond_id
WHERE 
    m.label = '+';

sql:
WITH loan_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        dist.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            ELSE 'Medium'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        l.status,
        COUNT(*) AS loan_count
    FROM 
        loan l
    JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN 
        district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
    WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        dist.A2, loan_size_category, l.status
),
status_c_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        loan_count AS c_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    WHERE 
        status = 'C'
),
total_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        SUM(loan_count) AS total_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    GROUP BY 
        region, loan_size_category
),
percentage_c AS (
    SELECT 
        tc.region,
        tc.loan_size_category,
        COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) AS c_count,
        tc.total_count,
        (COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) * 100.0 / tc.total_count) AS percentage_c
    FROM 
        total_counts tc
    LEFT JOIN 
        status_c_counts sc ON tc.region = sc.region AND tc.loan_size_category = sc.loan_size_category
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(percentage_c) AS overall_average_percentage_c
    FROM 
        percentage_c
)
SELECT 
    pc.region,
    pc.loan_size_category,
    pc.percentage_c,
    oa.overall_average_percentage_c,
    (pc.percentage_c - oa.overall_average_percentage_c) AS difference_from_average
FROM 
    percentage_c pc,
    overall_average oa
ORDER BY 
    pc.region, pc.loan_size_category;

    AVG(atom_count) AS avg_atoms_per_molecule,
    (SELECT AVG(bond_count) FROM (SELECT m.molecule_id, COUNT(b.bond_id) AS bond_count FROM molecule m JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '+' AND m.molecule_id = 'TR450' GROUP BY m.molecule_id)) AS avg_bonds_with_fluorine,
    (SELECT AVG(bond_count) FROM (SELECT m.molecule_id, COUNT(b.bond_id) AS bond_count FROM molecule m JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '+' AND m.molecule_id <> 'TR450' GROUP BY m.molecule_id)) AS avg_bonds_without_fluorine,
    AVG(bond_strength) AS avg_bond_strength
FROM 
    molecule m
LEFT JOIN 
    atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id AND a.element = 'f'
LEFT JOIN 
    (SELECT m.molecule_id, COUNT(a.atom_id) AS atom_count FROM molecule m JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '+' GROUP BY m.molecule_id) atom_counts ON m.molecule_id = atom_counts.molecule_id
LEFT JOIN

    m.label = '+';

            f."FRPM Count (K-12)" DESC

    satscores sat ON s."School Code" = sat.cds
ORDER BY

sql:
WITH loan_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        dist.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            ELSE 'Medium'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        l.status,
        COUNT(*) AS loan_count
    FROM 
        loan l
    JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN 
        district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
    WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        dist.A2, loan_size_category, l.status
),
status_c_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        loan_count AS c_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    WHERE 
        status = 'C'
),
total_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        SUM(loan_count) AS total_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    GROUP BY 
        region, loan_size_category
),
percentage_c AS (
    SELECT 
        tc.region,
        tc.loan_size_category,
        COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) AS c_count,
        tc.total_count,
        (COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) * 100.0 / tc.total_count) AS percentage_c
    FROM 
        total_counts tc
    LEFT JOIN 
        status_c_counts sc ON tc.region = sc.region AND tc.loan_size_category = sc.loan_size_category
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(percentage_c) AS overall_average_percentage_c
    FROM 
        percentage_c
)
SELECT 
    pc.region,
    pc.loan_size_category,
    pc.percentage_c,
    oa.overall_average_percentage_c,
    (pc.percentage_c - oa.overall_average_percentage_c) AS difference_from_average
FROM 
    percentage_c pc,
    overall_average oa;

WITH carcinogenic_molecules AS (
  SELECT m.molecule_id
  FROM molecule m
  WHERE m.label = '+'
),
fluorine_molecules AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
  FROM molecule m
  JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
  WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND a.element = 'f'
),
atoms_per_molecule AS (
  SELECT m.molecule_id, COUNT(a.atom_id) AS atom_count
  FROM molecule m
  JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
  WHERE m.label = '+'
  GROUP BY m.molecule_id
),
bonds_per_molecule AS (
  SELECT m.molecule_id, COUNT(b.bond_id) AS bond_count
  FROM molecule m
  JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
  WHERE m.label = '+'
  GROUP BY m.molecule_id
),
bond_strength_per_molecule AS (
  SELECT b.molecule_id,
         AVG(CASE b.bond_type
              WHEN '-' THEN 1
              WHEN '=' THEN 2
              WHEN '#' THEN 3
              ELSE 0

WITH loan_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        dist.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            ELSE 'Medium'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        l.status,
        COUNT(*) AS loan_count
    FROM 
        loan l
    JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN 
        district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
    WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        dist.A2, loan_size_category, l.status
),
status_c_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        loan_count AS c_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    WHERE 
        status = 'C'
),
total_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        SUM(loan_count) AS total_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    GROUP BY 
        region, loan_size_category
),
percentage_c AS (
    SELECT 
        tc.region,
        tc.loan_size_category,
        COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) AS c_count,
        tc.total_count,
        (COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) * 100.0 / tc.total_count) AS percentage_c
    FROM 
        total_counts tc
    LEFT JOIN 
        status_c_counts sc ON tc.region = sc.region AND tc.loan_size_category = sc.loan_size_category
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(percentage_c) AS overall_average_percentage_c
    FROM 
        percentage_c
)
SELECT 
    pc.region,
    pc.loan_size_category,
    pc.percentage_c,
    oa.overall_average_percentage_c,
    (pc.percentage_c - oa.overall_average_percentage_c) AS difference_from_average
FROM 
    percentage_c pc,
    overall_average oa
ORDER BY 
    pc.region, pc.loan_size_category;

WITH ElementCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2,
        COUNT(*) AS combination_count
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
),
MaxCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        molecule_id,
        MAX(combination_count) AS max_combination_count
    FROM 
        ElementCombinations
    GROUP BY 
        molecule_id
),
MostCommonCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        ec.molecule_id,
        ec.element1,
        ec.element2
    FROM 
        ElementCombinations ec
    JOIN 
        MaxCombinations mc ON ec.molecule_id = mc.molecule_id AND ec.combination_count = mc.max_combination_count
),
MostCommonCombinationBonds AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS most_common_combination_bond_count
    FROM 
        bond b
    JOIN 
        connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    JOIN 
        MostCommonCombinations mcc ON m.molecule_id = mcc.molecule_id AND a1.element = mcc.element1 AND a2.element = mcc.element2
),
TotalBonds AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(DISTINCT bond_id) AS total_bond_count
    FROM 
        bond
)
SELECT 
    (most_common_combination_bond_count * 100.0 / total_bond_count) AS percentage
FROM 
    MostCommonCombinationBonds, TotalBonds;

WITH loan_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        dist.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            ELSE 'Medium'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        l.status,
        COUNT(*) AS loan_count
    FROM 
        loan l
    JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN 
        district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
    WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        dist.A2, loan_size_category, l.status
),
status_c_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        loan_count AS c_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    WHERE 
        status = 'C'

total_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        SUM(loan_count) AS total_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    GROUP BY 
        region, loan_size_category
),
percentage_c AS (
    SELECT 
        tc.region,
        tc.loan_size_category,
        COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) AS c_count,
        tc.total_count,
        (COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) * 100.0 / tc.total_count) AS percentage_c
    FROM 
        total_counts tc
    LEFT JOIN 
        status_c_counts sc ON tc.region = sc.region AND tc.loan_size_category = sc.loan_size_category
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(percentage_c) AS overall_average_percentage_c
    FROM 
        percentage_c
)
SELECT 
    pc.region,
    pc.loan_size_category,
    pc.percentage_c,
    oa.overall_average_percentage_c,
    (pc.percentage_c - oa.overall_average_percentage_c) AS difference_from_average
FROM 
    percentage_c pc,
    overall_average oa
ORDER BY 
    pc.region, pc.loan_size_category;

sql:
WITH loan_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        dist.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            ELSE 'Medium'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        l.status,
        COUNT(*) AS loan_count
    FROM 
        loan l
    JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN 
        district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
    WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        dist.A2, loan_size_category, l.status
),
status_c_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        loan_count AS c_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    WHERE 
        status = 'C'
),
total_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        SUM(loan_count) AS total_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    GROUP BY 
        region, loan_size_category
),
percentage_c AS (
    SELECT 
        tc.region,
        tc.loan_size_category,
        COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) AS c_count,
        tc.total_count,
        (COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) * 100.0 / tc.total_count) AS percentage_c
    FROM 
        total_counts tc
    LEFT JOIN 
        status_c_counts sc ON tc.region = sc.region AND tc.loan_size_category = sc.loan_size_category
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(percentage_c) AS overall_average_percentage_c
    FROM 
        percentage_c
)
SELECT 
    pc.region,
    pc.loan_size_category,
    pc.percentage_c,
    oa.overall_average_percentage_c,
    (pc.percentage_c - oa.overall_average_percentage_c) AS difference_from_average
FROM 
    percentage_c pc,
    overall_average oa;

WITH gold_cards AS (
    SELECT c.card_id, c.issued, d.disp_id, cl.district_id, di.A3 AS region
    FROM card c
    JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
    JOIN client cl ON d.client_id = cl.client_id
    JOIN district di ON cl.district_id = di.district_id
    WHERE c.type = 'gold'
),
gold_cards_before_1998 AS (
    SELECT card_id, issued, disp_id, district_id, region
    FROM gold_cards
    WHERE issued < '1998-01-01'
)
SELECT 
    region,
    COUNT(*) AS total_gold_cards,
    COUNT(gcb.issued) AS gold_cards_before_1998,
    COUNT(gcb.issued) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage_before_1998
FROM gold_cards
LEFT JOIN gold_cards_before_1998 gcb ON gold_cards.card_id = gcb.card_id
GROUP BY region
WITH ROLLUP;

WITH TopFRPM AS (
    SELECT 
        f."School Code",
        f."School Name",
        f."FRPM Count (K-12)",
        f."Enrollment (K-12)",
        (f."FRPM Count (K-12)" / f."Enrollment (K-12)") * 100 AS "Eligibility Rate (%)"
    FROM 
        frpm f
    JOIN 
        schools s ON CAST(f."School Code" AS VARCHAR) = s.CDSCode
    WHERE 
        s.SOC = '66'
    ORDER BY 
        f."FRPM Count (K-12)" DESC
    LIMIT 5
),
SATMetrics AS (
    SELECT 
        s.CDSCode,
        s."School",
        ss.NumTstTakr,
        ss.AvgScrRead,
        ss.AvgScrMath,
        ss.AvgScrWrite,
        ss.NumGE1500,
        s."School" AS "School Name"
    FROM 
        schools s
    JOIN 
        satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
    WHERE 
        s.SOC = '66'
)
SELECT 
    t."School Name",
    t."Eligibility Rate (%)",
    sm.NumTstTakr,
    sm.AvgScrRead,
    sm.AvgScrMath,
    sm.AvgScrWrite,
    sm.NumGE1500,
    (sm.NumTstTakr / NULLIF(f."Enrollment (K-12)", 0)) * 100 AS "SAT Participation Rate (%)",
    (sm.NumGE1500 / NULLIF(sm.NumTstTakr, 0)) * 100 AS "High Scorer Rate (%)"
FROM 
    TopFRPM t
LEFT JOIN 
    SATMetrics sm ON t."School Name" = sm."School Name"
LEFT JOIN 
    frpm f ON CAST(t."School Code" AS VARCHAR) = f."School Code";
